grammar_focus: 被动语态各时态(一般现在被动 are sent/is visited、一般过去被动 was founded/were used、现在完成被动 has been built、情态/不定式被动 have to be kept/are allowed to),外加 -ever 复合词(whenever/wherever/whoever/whatever 加强语气)(原创承载 NCE3 L8 考点·落基山口老修道院与圣伯纳德救援犬)
scene: 落基山脉高处,鹰山口连着两条幽静的山谷。海拔一万一千多英尺,是全国最高的山口之一。近两百年前建起的一座石砌老修道院,就坐落在离顶不到一英里的地方。多少代以来,人们在那儿养着高大的圣伯纳德犬,专门营救被困雪中的旅人。这些温和的狗当初主要当看门狗养,如今只要有徒步者遇险,仍会被放出去闯进风雪。如今山中修了公路,山口安全多了。即便如此,还是有少数人冒冒失失地徒步翻越,而狗随时待命。夏天,修道院热闹非凡,成千上万开车上山的游客来参观。人一多,狗就得关进专门的围场。可一到冬天,一切都变了:气温降到零下很多,几乎没人来。修道士们更爱冬天,因为终于能清静些;狗也自由些,获准想去哪儿就去哪儿。冬天唯一的常客,是圣诞和复活节前来的一队队滑雪者。无论谁那时来访,总会受到热情的欢迎。

grammar_card.title: 被动语态各时态 + -ever 复合词
grammar_card.intro: ①被动语态=be + 过去分词,表示“被……”:一般现在被动 is/are + done(the dogs are sent out / it is visited)、一般过去被动 was/were + done(the monastery was founded / the dogs were used)、现在完成被动 has/have been + done(a highway has been built)、情态或不定式的被动(the dogs have to be kept / are allowed to wander)。be 用什么时态,就表达什么时候“被……”。②-ever 复合词:who/what/when/where/how 加 -ever,表示“无论谁/什么/何时/何地/怎样”,用来加强语气——whenever(无论何时)、wherever(无论何处)、whoever(无论谁)、whatever(无论什么)。

rows: The dogs are sent out. / It is visited by tourists.
The monastery was founded long ago.
A highway has been built through the pass.

specialRules.rule: 被动语态里,动作的承受者放在前面,be 决定时态:are kept(现在被关着)、were kept(过去被关着)、have been kept(到现在一直被关着)。情态词后用 be + 过去分词(must be kept / have to be kept)。
-ever 复合词既能当连词引导让步(Whoever comes is welcome 无论谁来都欢迎),也能加强疑问语气(Wherever has he gone? 他到底去哪儿了)。
美语里“假期”说 vacation(英式 holiday);“毛衣”说 sweater(英式 jumper)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What are the St. Bernard dogs used for?
options: Rescuing travelers caught in the snow

passage: High in the Rocky Mountains, Eagle Pass connects two quiet valleys. At over eleven thousand feet, it is one of the highest passes in the country. An old stone monastery, which was founded almost two hundred years ago, stands about a mile from the top. For generations, big St. Bernard dogs have been kept there to rescue travelers caught in the snow. These gentle dogs, which were first raised as watchdogs, are still sent out into the storms whenever a hiker is in trouble. A modern highway has now been built through the mountains, so the pass is much safer. Even so, a few people still rashly try to cross it on foot, and the dogs are always ready. During the summer, the monastery is crowded, for it is visited by thousands of tourists who drive up to see it. Because so many people are around, the dogs have to be kept inside a special enclosure. In winter, however, everything changes. The temperature drops far below zero, and hardly anyone comes. The monks prefer winter to summer, because they finally have some privacy. The dogs are given more freedom, too, and are allowed to wander wherever they like. The only regular guests in winter are groups of skiers who arrive at Christmas and Easter. Whoever visits then is always given a warm welcome.

stage5.stem: "Each winter, the dogs ___ out into the snow to help lost hikers."(一般现在被动:are + 过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 每年冬天,这些狗都被派进雪中去帮迷路的徒步者。

stage5.stem: "In summer, the monastery ___ by thousands of tourists."(一般现在被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 夏天,修道院被成千上万的游客参观。

stage5.stem: "When crowds come, the dogs ___ inside an enclosure."(一般现在被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 人群一来,狗就被关进围场里。

stage5.stem: "The old monastery ___ almost two hundred years ago."(一般过去被动:was + 过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 这座老修道院建于将近两百年前。

stage5.stem: "Long ago, these dogs ___ mainly as watchdogs."(一般过去被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 很久以前,这些狗主要被当作看门狗养。

stage5.stem: "The first rescue dogs ___ here from far away."(一般过去被动:bring 的过去分词 brought)
stage5.stem_cn: 最早的救援犬是从很远的地方带到这里的。

stage5.stem: "A modern highway ___ through the mountains, so the pass is safer now."(现在完成被动:has been + 过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 山中已修通一条现代公路,如今山口安全多了。

stage5.stem: "Over the years, many lives ___ by these brave dogs."(现在完成被动:have been + 过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 多年来,这些勇敢的狗救过许多人的命。

stage5.stem: "Because of the crowds, the dogs have to ___ inside the enclosure."(情态词后的被动:be + 过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 由于人多,狗不得不被关在围场里。

stage5.stem: "In winter the dogs ___ to wander wherever they like."(表示“被准许做某事”)
stage5.stem_cn: 冬天,狗获准想去哪儿就去哪儿。

stage5.stem: "The dogs are sent out ___ a hiker is in trouble."(“无论什么时候……都”,用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 只要有徒步者遇险,狗就被派出去。

stage5.stem: "In winter the dogs may go ___ they like."(“无论在哪里”,用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 冬天,狗想去哪儿就去哪儿。

stage5.stem: "___ visits the monastery in winter gets a warm welcome."(“无论谁”,用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 无论谁冬天来访,都会受到热情欢迎。

stage5.stem: "The monks share ___ food they have with the skiers."(“无论什么、凡是”,用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 修道士们把自己有的食物都分给滑雪者。

stage5.stem: "A religious house where monks live and pray is a ___."(“修道院”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 僧侣居住、祈祷的宗教场所是修道院。

stage5.stem: "During the busy season the dogs are kept in a fenced ___."(“围场、圈地”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 旺季时狗被关在带围栏的围场里。

stage5.stem: "People who slide down snowy slopes on long boards are ___."(“滑雪者”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 踩着长板从雪坡滑下的人是滑雪者。

stage5.stem: "In winter the quiet monks finally enjoy some ___."(“清静、隐私”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 冬天,清静的修道士终于享受到一些安宁。
